dedupe_keys.name: monitoring the storage volume of water reservoirs using google earth engine

description: Monitoring the storage volume of water reservoirs using Google Earth Engine is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Condeça, Joaquim (deposited on HydroShare). Recently, the satellite images have been used in remote sensing allowing observations with high temporal and spatial distribution. The use of water indices has proved to be an effective methodology in the monitoring of surface water resources. However, precise or automatic methodologies using satellite imagery to determine reservoir volumes are lacking. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2021-04-22 and last updated 2021-04-22; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
